Warmth
red minus blue, per pixel, scaled to −1…+1. Reds and oranges push it up, blues push it down.
Saturation
how vivid a pixel is, from 0 (grey, white, black) to 1 (pure colour).
Embedding
each image becomes the average over all 2,500 pixels. Blank pixels count as neutral (0, 0), so more paint means a longer vector.
